Evidence: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) announced that they are ready to form the government in Delhi, with Arvind Kejriwal making this announcement. He met with Lt Governor Najeeb Jung to submit the claim to form the government, and the LG assured him that the claim would be forwarded to the President. Kejriwal stated that the swearing-in date would be set through mutual consultation, with Ramlila Maidan as the venue. AAP leader Manish Sisodiya confirmed that Kejriwal would be the next Chief Minister, dismissing rumors of anyone else taking the position. Kejriwal is expected to take the oath on December 26 (Source 1).
Justification: The retrieved evidence directly corroborates the claim that Kejriwal is staking a claim to form the government and that the swearing-in will occur at Ramlila Maidan. Source 1 explicitly states that Kejriwal announced the formation of the government, submitted his claim to the Lt Governor, and confirmed Ramlila Maidan as the swearing-in venue. Additionally, it mentions the expected date for the oath of office, supporting the core assertion of the claim.
